taxonomic_note: Legacy Master Plant Pool name Tridens buckleyanus normalized to current accepted Tridentopsis buckleyana.
look_here_first: Small Texas fluffgrass relative with a compact seedhead and conspicuous cottony or fluffy hairs around the spikelets at maturity.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local source; WFO 2026 accepts Tridentopsis buckleyana and lists Tridens buckleyanus as a synonym.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; exact target-zone county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Poaceae: use growth habit, ligule, panicle architecture, spikelet form, lemma hairs and awns. For this old Tridens complex, panicle openness/color and current genus placement are especially useful.
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The fluffier seedhead is the field memory hook. Taxonomically it belongs in Tridentopsis, not Tridens, in modern WFO/WCVP treatment.
